name: gramkit
description: Video speed, seek and volume controls, keyboard shortcuts and focus tools for Instagram on the web. Chrome, Zen and Firefox.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox /Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --start-url https://www.instagram.com/
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome --start-url https://www.instagram.com/
